verses.text: “So remember Me; I will remember you.”

end.text: 8,000 steps today. Not one inside the masjid.
end.gold: Tonight: walk to the masjid for Isha.

captions: Gym. Office. Shops. Your watch counts them all.
Every day, you pass this door. Twice.
The light is on. The adhan calls. You keep walking.
Ten more steps. But your feet go home.
Tonight, you stop at the door. Shoes off.
Ten steps. The carpet is soft. The rows are open.
Shoulder to shoulder. You belong here.
The best ten steps you took all day.

post.caption:
8,000 steps today. Not one inside the masjid. 👟

Every day you pass the door. The light is on. The adhan calls. You keep walking.

“So remember Me; I will remember you.” (2:152)

Tonight: walk to the masjid for Isha. Ten steps. Shoes off. You belong here. 🕌
